title: Three Hotta Siblings Murder Case
notes: Recurring detective-cast nodes (Conan, Kogoro Mouri, Ran) omitted by convention. No `event` node type: every action is a directly typed, attributed edge between the entities involved (person/location/object), sharing an `order` integer so edges belonging to the same occurrence can be grouped without a reifying node. Three red-herring has_motive_against edges are included (Koichi, Ryoji, Fumiko all have real grievances/suspicion against their father) alongside the true culprit's motive, correcting v1's near-total label leak. Ryoji is additionally the target of a staged frame-up (planted knife/tire-slashing) that the graph represents as a red herring, not as real implication. case_type: murder.

clues.desc: Garden dirt and chemical fertilizer residue found inside the exploded whiskey box show the bomb was homemade from fertilizer and sulfur available to household staff, not a purchased explosive -- narrowing the suspect pool to someone with access to the villa's grounds and materials.

If Ryoji had really planted the bomb in his own gift box, he would already be the prime suspect without needing to also slash his own car's tires -- the pointless extra step, plus a knife with rubber residue conveniently left near his abandoned car, proves the tire-slashing was staged to frame him.
